items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() — joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts. The registry's own copy: the default shadcn "utils" pulled a stray npm package "cn" with shadcn 4.11 (found 2026-09-25).

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Headings, body text, lead, small print and metric numbers of the design system.

items.name: tone
items.title: Tones
items.description: The five semantic tones of blocks (data, reach, access, code, muted) and the badge class.

items.name: inline
items.title: Inline markup
items.description: **bold** and [links](url) inside a line of text; external links open in a new tab.

items.name: page-body
items.title: Page body
items.description: The page factory: a page is a list of { kind, ...fields }; the set names only the blocks this project has.

items.name: block-section-head
items.title: Section head
items.description: Badge, heading and lead of a section.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-section-head. In a page: { "kind": "block-section-head", "id": "roles", "title": "Roles" }.

meta.use: The heading of a section with an anchor: the blocks after it belong to the section.
meta.avoid: Before block-cards, block-flow or block-showcase-frame (they print the same head themselves); two heads in a row.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-section-head'; id: string; title: string; badge?: string }

cases.title: A section that groups the paragraphs after it
cases.why: The anchor and the heading make the section findable from a table of contents.

items.name: block-cta-button
items.title: CTA button
items.description: The main action: a primary-colour pill with an arrow, the same look as the first screen of the site. Theme tokens only.
items.docs: Installed with block-hero-centered (registry dependency). Not a page kind: set cta or secondary on the hero.

meta.use: An action button with an arrow inside the first screen; it arrives through the cta and secondary fields of block-hero-centered.
meta.avoid: A page sequence (it is not a page kind); a form submit button.

cases.title: The main action of a first screen
cases.why: One clear action next to the title.

items.name: block-hero-centered
items.title: Hero, centered
items.description: Centered first screen: brand-colour glow, animated badge, title of at most two lines, description, optional CTA and optional second (outline) CTA and a strip of three steps. Theme tokens and typography primitives only; needs .hero-ignite, .hero-appear and .pill-ai from the design system.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-hero-centered. In a page sequence: { "kind": "block-hero-centered", "title": "…", "description": "…", "cta": { "label": "…", "href": "…" } } as the first block (after breadcrumbs, if any).

meta.use: The first screen of a page without a picture: a badge, a title of at most two lines, one sentence, one or two actions and, if needed, three steps.
meta.avoid: A first screen that needs a picture or a figure beside the title; any place but the first screen of a page.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-hero-centered'; pill?: string; title: string; description: string; cta?: { label: string; href: string }; secondary?: { label: string; href: string }; steps?: [{ title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }] }

variants.label: With three steps under the actions

cases.title: Home page of a service: what it is and two actions
cases.why: With no picture, the title and the actions are the whole offer of the first screen.

props.title: Sign-in for every application on your node
props.description: One service keeps the accounts, roles and sign-in methods of every application.

cases.title: Launch page that shows how to start in three steps
cases.why: The three steps answer «how do I start» before the reader scrolls.

props.title: Your own site on your own computer
props.description: Install the node, open the panel, publish the first page.

steps.title: Open
steps.text: The panel opens in the browser.

items.name: block-metrics
items.title: Metrics
items.description: A row of three or four measures: a number and what it refers to.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-metrics. In a page: { "kind": "block-metrics", "items": [ { "value": "82", "label": "…" }, … three items ] }. The value is not translated; the label is a page string.

meta.use: Three numbers that prove a claim, each with what it counts: a short number answers «is that actually true?» instead of a paragraph.
meta.avoid: More or fewer than three measures; numbers nobody measured; related values that need a table.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-metrics'; items: { value: string; label: string }[] }

cases.title: Three numbers about a service: languages, access tiers, roles
cases.why: Each number is measured and says what it counts.

cases.title: Stats of a product launch: sign-ups, uptime, response time
cases.why: Proof in numbers right after the claim it supports.

items.label: people signed up in the first month

items.name: block-badges
items.title: Badges
items.description: A row of short labels, coloured by semantic group.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-badges. In a page: { "kind": "block-badges", "items": [ { "label": "…", "tone": "data" } ] }.

meta.use: A row of short labels that says «it can do all of this» without a paragraph; the tone groups labels by meaning.
meta.avoid: Sentences; a list where the order matters; more than about twenty labels.

cases.title: Roles an application can assign, grouped by meaning
cases.why: Twelve names read at a glance; the tone shows which group each belongs to.

items.name: block-cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A section of cards: head and a grid of 2 or 3 columns.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-cards (brings block-card). In a page: { "kind": "block-cards", "title": "…", "cols": 3, "children": [ { "kind": "block-card", "children": [ text blocks ] } ] }.

meta.use: A section of equal cards with no order between them: what the product is made of, or the options to choose from.
meta.avoid: Steps that follow each other (use block-flow); a single card; cards of different importance.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-cards'; title: string; badge?: string; note?: string; cols?: 2 | 3; blockKey?: string; children: Block[] }

cases.title: Three access tiers of a sign-in service
cases.why: Three equal options the reader compares; no order between them.

props.title: Roles
props.note: Roles decide what a signed-in person may read and change.

children.text: A signed-in person with an account.

items.name: block-card
items.title: Card
items.description: One card: a frame with a tone fill; any blocks inside.
items.docs: Installed with block-cards. Only inside block-cards: { "kind": "block-card", "tone": "data", "children": [ { "kind": "text-h3", … }, { "kind": "text-p", … } ] }.

meta.use: One card inside block-cards: a tinted frame around a short heading and a sentence or two.
meta.avoid: A page by itself (put it inside block-cards); long text.

cases.title: A feature card: a short heading and one sentence
cases.why: The tone groups the card with its meaning; the text stays short.

children.text: A guest signs in with an email address alone.

items.name: block-flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: How it works: three steps, one leading to the next.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-flow. In a page: { "kind": "block-flow", "title": "…", "steps": [ three { "title", "text" } ] }. Styles .flow* come with the theme.

meta.use: How something works in exactly three steps that follow each other; the order is the content. Steps light up in turn with pure CSS.
meta.avoid: Items without an order (use block-cards); more or fewer than three steps.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-flow'; title: string; badge?: string; note?: string; blockKey?: string; steps: [{ title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }] }

cases.title: Set up a service in three steps
cases.why: Each step needs the one before it, so the order carries the meaning.

props.title: Set it up in three steps
props.note: A provider without its keys stays off.

steps.title: Add Google
steps.text: Set the client ID and secret on the node.

items.name: app-dialog
items.title: App dialog
items.description: The project's one modal window: fixed heading and footer, scrolling body, sizes sm/md/lg, an undismissable mode for refusing access.

items.name: block-dialog-sample
items.title: Dialog sample
items.description: One setting of the app dialog opened by a button: plain, with a footer, long (the body scrolls), cannot be dismissed.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-dialog-sample (brings app-dialog). Use AppDialog in a tool; this block shows its four settings.

meta.use: An example of the node's one dialog component (AppDialog) in one of four settings: plain, with a footer, long, cannot be dismissed — for building a dialog in a tool.
meta.avoid: A page block (it is not a page kind); a dialog of your own instead of AppDialog.

cases.title: A reference window: read and close
cases.why: Reference text that needs no decision opens in the plain setting.

words.name: Plain window
words.title: About roles
words.longLine: One more line of the long text.
words.lockedHint: This window closes only by its button.

items.name: block-section-separator
items.title: Section separator
items.description: A horizontal line between two parts of a page.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-section-separator. In a page: { "kind": "block-section-separator" }.

meta.use: A visible line between two parts of a page where the boundary must be seen, not guessed from spacing.
meta.avoid: First or last on a page; between every two sections.

cases.title: A boundary between the product story and the pricing part
cases.why: Two parts of different purpose read as separate.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: The path to this page with BreadcrumbList markup — one source for the visitor and the search engine.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-breadcrumbs. In a page: { "kind": "block-breadcrumbs", "items": [ { "label": "Home", "href": "/en" }, { "label": "This page" } ] } first.

meta.use: The path from the home page to this page, above the first screen, with BreadcrumbList structured data for search.
meta.avoid: The home page itself; more than one per page.
meta.props: { kind: 'block-breadcrumbs'; items: { label: string; href?: string }[] }

cases.title: Path to a page of documentation
cases.why: The reader sees where the page sits and goes one level up.

items.name: block-faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions and answers with FAQPage markup; the answer allows inline links.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-faq. In a page: { "kind": "block-faq", "title": "…", "items": [ { "q": "…", "a": "…" } ] } as the last block.

meta.use: Questions and answers at the end of a page; search engines read them as FAQPage structured data.
meta.avoid: Anywhere but the end of a page; answers with markdown marks (they go into structured data verbatim).
meta.props: { kind: 'block-faq'; title: string; items: { q: string; a: string }[] }

cases.title: Questions a buyer asks before signing up
cases.why: Answers the doubts that remain after the page, and search engines show them as answers.

items.q: Do I need a credit card?
items.a: No. You can start without one.

items.name: block-showcase-frame
items.title: Showcase frame
items.description: A section menu on the left and a preview frame on the right — no client JavaScript: menu links open in the frame by target.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-showcase-frame. In a page: { "kind": "block-showcase-frame", "id": "…", "title": "…", "menuTitle": "…", "frameTitle": "…", "items": [ { "id", "label", "href" } ] }.

meta.use: A menu of pages on the left and a live frame on the right that opens the chosen one: a showcase of several working pages.
meta.avoid: Pages that refuse to be framed; a page read mostly on phones (the frame takes most of the screen).
meta.props: { kind: 'block-showcase-frame'; id: string; badge?: string; title: string; note?: string; menuTitle: string; frameTitle: string; items: { id: string; label: string; href: string }[] }

cases.title: Showcase of the sections of a block catalogue
cases.why: Several working pages viewed in one place without leaving the page.

items.name: block-warning-card
items.title: Warning card
items.description: A warning: the cost or risk of a decision the person is about to take. Title and text in the theme destructive tone; no colours of its own.
items.docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-warning-card. In a page: { "kind": "block-warning-card", "title": "…", "text": "…" }.

meta.use: A warning about the price or the risk of a decision the reader is about to make.
meta.avoid: Ordinary notes or tips; more than one or two per page.

cases.title: The risk of setting up sign-in late
cases.why: The reader is about to postpone a decision that is expensive to postpone.

props.title: Set it up early
props.text: If sign-in breaks, nobody can open the protected pages, architects included.
